name: documentary_validation
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
for f in ['review.json','source-map.json','scope-comparison96.json']:json.loads(Path(f).read_text())
r=json.loads(Path('scope-comparison96.json').read_text());assert len(r['rows'])==96
s=Path('REVIEW.md').read_text()+'''\nTerminal byte-manifest exclusions, exactly: MANIFEST.json (self-reference), seal_manifest.receipt.json and seal_manifest.output.txt (created by the supervising immutable runner only after the sealing child exits). These three are the only exclusions. The terminal receipt/output cannot noncircularly attest their own bytes; they remain available as terminal runner evidence. All other own files, including inputs/helpers/plans if any/payloads if any/saved fullresponses if supplied/ledgers/receipts/renderings/products/frozen-after.json, are included. Receipt inventory and manifest are built from own-lane files only. No later tool work after the sealing call.\n\nAuthor-input read inventory: raw/literal/provenance, FULLCANDIDATE, source-read inventory, NETWORK-STOP, reporting errata, author gates and supplied source-plan JSONs read. DORMANT-SOL-FORMAL-PLAN.md and supplied old search-response bodies not personally opened; preserved and byte-manifested without relying on their assertions. Actual source PDFs were rendered/viewed only at the source-map page lists. No fresh URL current-status assertion.\n'''
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'REVIEW.md'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
print('Documentary JSON shapes and96 comparison row count verified. Required products present:',[f for f in ['PROOF.md','REVIEW.md','source-audit.md','review.json','source-map.json','scope-comparison96.json'] if Path(f).is_file()])
print('Completed attempts',[(x.name,json.loads(x.read_text()).get('exit')) for x in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json'))])
print('Search budget',Path('search-budget.json').read_text())
